capabilities: Select unsupported files on single click without opening them
Open unsupported files in the OS default app on double click
Leave natively supported files (Markdown, PDF, images, audio, video) untouched
Configure treated extensions by editing the NATIVE set in main.js
extras: Desktop only; requires Settings → Files and links → Detect all file extensions to be enabled for unsupported files to appear in the explorer. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted to prevent accidental launches of external apps and make unsupported files behave like a desktop file manager.
problem: By default, clicking an unsupported file in Obsidian's file explorer can immediately launch an external application, causing accidental opens.
summary: File explorer modifier that makes unsupported files select on single click and open in the OS default app only on double click.
